text:
Task: produce a work plan assigning all modules to workers alpha–delta that satisfies every constraint below. Plan 26 modules: auth, ledger, search, upload, alerts, session, catalog, indexer, archive, export, tenant, profile, media, cache, inventory, checkout, pricing, gateway, quota, backup, notify, shipping, audit, webhooks.

Fixed: webhooks.max_workers=20 webhooks.timeout_s=40 search.max_workers=16 search.queue_depth=90 archive.max_workers=26 ledger.max_workers=32 inventory.max_workers=16 inventory.ttl_s=360 upload.ttl_s=360 tenant.timeout_s=75 tenant.queue_depth=440 export.ttl_s=270 cache.timeout_s=25 backup.queue_depth=400 media.batch_size=700 audit.ttl_s=510

Rules: backup.queue_depth>380→cache.max_workers≥32 inventory.ttl_s>270→notify.max_workers≤6 audit.ttl_s>420→auth.max_workers≤4 inventory.max_workers>12→upload.batch_size≤200 webhooks.timeout_s>25→shipping.retry_limit≥8 tenant.timeout_s>65→alerts.batch_size≥800 archive.max_workers>22→gateway.queue_depth≥480 webhooks.max_workers>14→gateway.max_workers≤4

Deps: indexer, search, export, quota→catalog; catalog→auth; profile→webhooks; cache→indexer; gateway→export.

Never (even transitively): archive→media, archive→upload, alerts→gateway, shipping→inventory.

Rollout: webhooks<alerts, shipping<checkout, indexer<notify. Run order: session<ledger.

Owners: alpha=webhooks,search,quota; beta=tenant,archive,media,session; gamma=alerts,export; delta=auth.

Files: queues.py→webhooks, limits.py→search, hooks.py→gateway, store.py→alerts, guard.py→tenant, fixtures.py→inventory, worker.py→notify, codec.py→backup.

Same worker: cache+audit, archive+tenant, export+alerts, webhooks+quota. Separate workers: gateway|upload, audit|webhooks, auth|notify, checkout|tenant.

Other choices are team judgment.
